skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the basic concepts and legal frameworks related to anti-corruption, including international and Vietnamese laws, and the responsibilities of entities involved in anti-corruption efforts.
Apply communication skills in group work, presentations, and discussions.
Develop independent research skills to accumulate and enhance knowledge.
Analyze and solve problems related to anti-corruption and legal compliance.
Effectively present research findings and engage in discussions.
Understand and apply international legal frameworks related to anti-corruption.
Understand and apply legal compliance measures in anti-corruption efforts.
Understand ethical considerations in anti-corruption and legal compliance.
